{{Quote|<small>STADIUM ONE: LEFT ON USIRINE STREET</small>|The text of a sign in Eusebus|<ref name="Dangerous Game" />}}
'''Stadium One''' was a sporting stadium located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eusebus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Euceron]]. It could be reached from the [[main boulevard of Eusebus]] by turning left onto [[Usirine Street]]. During the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] of [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], the Opening Rituals for the Games were held in Stadium One.<ref name="Dangerous Game" />
